proposals.evidence: DEDR 1159(a) gives Tamil kaṇ, Malayalam/Kannada kaṇ(ṇu), Gadaba kaṇ/kanu, Kurukh xann, Malto qanu and Brahui xan ‘eye’. These simple eye responses select subsection (a); the tears compounds in subsection (b) are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
